description: This file defines the SearchResult interface for representing search query results within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.thingsearch package. It includes methods for accessing search items, pagination info, and JSON serialization details.

classes.name: SearchResult.JsonFields
classes.description: Contains JSON field definitions for SearchResult properties such as schema version, items, next page offset, and cursor.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder for constructing a SearchResult object.

methods.name: toBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder initialized with the properties of the current SearchResult instance.

methods.name: getItems
methods.description: Returns the list of search items as a JsonArray.

methods.name: getNextPageOffset
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the offset for the next page, or empty if none.

methods.name: getCursor
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the cursor for paginated results.

methods.name: hasNextPage
methods.description: Indicates whether there are more pages of results.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the search result.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Indicates whether the search result contains no items.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Provides a Stream<JsonValue> of the search items.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the object to JSON, including only non-hidden fields.
